question: List all customers from Brazil
generated_sql: SELECT * FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: How many customers does each country have?
generated_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

question: What is the total sales revenue per country?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  BillingCountry,
  SUM(Total)
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY
  BillingCountry;

question: What is the average invoice total per country?
generated_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: What are the top 5 longest tracks in minutes?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  Name,
  CAST(Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000 AS LengthInMinutes
FROM Track
ORDER BY
  LengthInMinutes DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: What was the best single month for revenue ever?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS SalesMonth
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY
  SalesMonth
ORDER BY
  SUM(Total) DESC
LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue per month across all years?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS Month,
  SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY
  Month
ORDER BY
  Month;

question: Which customers have made more than 5 purchases?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  C.CustomerId,
  C.FirstName,
  C.LastName
FROM Customer AS C
JOIN Invoice AS I
  ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId
GROUP BY
  C.CustomerId,
  C.FirstName,
  C.LastName
HAVING
  COUNT(I.InvoiceId) > 5;

question: Which employees support the most customers?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  T1.FirstName,
  T1.LastName
FROM Employee AS T1
JOIN Customer AS T2
  ON T1.EmployeeId = T2.SupportRepId
GROUP BY
  T1.EmployeeId
HAVING
  COUNT(T2.CustomerId) = (
    SELECT
      MAX(CustomerCount)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        COUNT(T2.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
      FROM Employee AS T1
      JOIN Customer AS T2
        ON T1.EmployeeId = T2.SupportRepId
      GROUP BY
        T1.EmployeeId
    )
  );

question: List all albums with their artist names sorted alphabetically by artist
generated_sql:
SELECT
  T1.Title,
  T2.Name
FROM Album AS T1
INNER JOIN Artist AS T2
  ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId
ORDER BY
  T2.Name;

question: What are the top 10 best selling tracks by quantity sold?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  T.Name
FROM Track AS T
JOIN InvoiceLine AS IL
  ON T.TrackId = IL.TrackId
GROUP BY
  T.TrackId,
  T.Name
ORDER BY
  SUM(IL.Quantity) DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: Which sales rep generated the most revenue from their customers?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  E.FirstName,
  E.LastName
FROM Employee AS E
JOIN Customer AS C
  ON E.EmployeeId = C.SupportRepId
JOIN Invoice AS I
  ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId
GROUP BY
  E.EmployeeId
ORDER BY
  SUM(I.Total) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average revenue per customer by country?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  c.Country,
  AVG(i.Total) AS AverageRevenuePerCustomer
FROM Customer AS c
JOIN Invoice AS i
  ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY
  c.Country;

question: Who is the top spending customer in each country?
generated_sql:
WITH CustomerTotalSpending AS (
  SELECT
    C.CustomerId,
    C.FirstName,
    C.LastName,
    C.Country,
    SUM(I.Total) AS TotalSpent
  FROM Customer AS C
  JOIN Invoice AS I
    ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId
  GROUP BY
    C.CustomerId,
    C.FirstName,
    C.LastName,
    C.Country
), RankedCustomerSpending AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerId,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    Country,
    TotalSpent,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Country ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC) AS RankNum
  FROM CustomerTotalSpending
)
SELECT
  FirstName,
  LastName,
  Country,
  TotalSpent
FROM RankedCustomerSpending
WHERE
  RankNum = 1;

question: How many tracks does each genre have?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  T2.Name,
  COUNT(T1.TrackId)
FROM Track AS T1
INNER JOIN Genre AS T2
  ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId
GROUP BY
  T2.Name;

question: Which customers spent more than the average customer spending?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  C.CustomerId,
  C.FirstName,
  C.LastName
FROM Customer AS C
JOIN Invoice AS I
  ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId
GROUP BY
  C.CustomerId,
  C.FirstName,
  C.LastName
HAVING
  SUM(I.Total) > (
    SELECT
      AVG(CustomerTotal)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        SUM(Total) AS CustomerTotal
      FROM Invoice
      GROUP BY
        CustomerId
    )
  );

question: Which genre generates the most revenue?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  T3.Name
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
INNER JOIN Track AS T2
  ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId
INNER JOIN Genre AS T3
  ON T2.GenreId = T3.GenreId
GROUP BY
  T3.Name
ORDER BY
  SUM(T1.UnitPrice * T1.Quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which artist generated the highest total revenue?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  T2.Name
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
INNER JOIN Track AS T3

INNER JOIN Album AS T4

INNER JOIN Artist AS T2
  ON T4.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId
GROUP BY

question: What is the revenue ranking of all artists?
generated_sql:
SELECT
  T3.Name,
  SUM(T1.UnitPrice * T1.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
FROM InvoiceLine AS T1
INNER JOIN Track AS T2
  ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId
INNER JOIN Album AS T4
  ON T2.AlbumId = T4.AlbumId
INNER JOIN Artist AS T3
  ON T4.ArtistId = T3.ArtistId
GROUP BY
  T3.Name
ORDER BY
  TotalRevenue DESC;
